definitions.gloss: history; development; historical background (of an organization or institution)
definitions.explanation: Often used for official histories of companies, institutions, or organizations.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{沿革|えんかく}を{調|しら}べた。
{沿革|えんかく}のページには{創業|そうぎょう}から{現在|げんざい}までの{歴史|れきし}が{書|か}かれている。
examples.english: The history page describes the story from founding to the present.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{沿革|えんかく}は100{年|ねん}にわたる。

notes:
{沿革|えんかく} refers to the historical development of an organization.

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・{会社|かいしゃ}の{沿革|えんかく} - company history
・{学校|がっこう}の{沿革|えんかく} - school history
・{組織|そしき}の{沿革|えんかく} - organizational history

WEBSITE USAGE:
Many Japanese corporate websites have a {沿革|えんかく} page providing a timeline of key events.

RELATED:
・{歴史|れきし} - history (general)
・{変遷|へんせん} - transition, changes over time
・{由来|ゆらい} - origin, derivation
